cases.name: Brenda Joyce Warne
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Brenda lived a life marked by faith, devotion, and a deep love for the people around her. She was a Christian whose life reflected the values she held dear, and she was especially known for her steady presence, generous spirit, and willingness to serve others without hesitation. Brenda’s life was rooted in her community and in her family, and she carried herself with a kindness that left a lasting impression on everyone she met.

Brenda was deeply involved in her church and found great purpose in her work with Kairos Ministry. Her faith was not simply something she professed, but something she lived each day through her actions, her compassion, and her care for others. She had a servant’s heart and was always happiest when she was helping someone in need. Whether offering comfort, lending a hand, or simply being there to listen, Brenda made it a priority to put others before herself. Her gentle strength and loving nature were gifts to all who knew her. Family was the center of Brenda’s life, and she cherished every moment spent with those she loved."
